decls.name: allSimple
decls.head: def allSimple (C : WeilConfig) : Prop := ∀ ρ ∈ C.carrier, C.mult ρ = 1

decls.name: simplicity_iff
decls.head: theorem simplicity_iff : simplicity ↔ ∀ ρ : ℂ, Zeta23.IsNontrivialZero ρ → Zeta23.zeroMult ρ = 1 :=

decls.name: exceptional_mass_le_third
decls.head:
theorem exceptional_mass_le_third (hP : SimpleProportion) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T ≥ T₀,
      (Zeta23.Ncount T (2 * T) : ℝ) - (Zeta23.N0simple T (2 * T) : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 3 + ε) * (Zeta23.Ncount T (2 * T) : ℝ) := by
